answer: A cedar-strong defence starts with a whisper-quiet bond: each agent locks 80 POA and a hardware key, then earns trust in four steps. First, it completes 10 verified micro-jobs over 10 days. Second, two agents vouch for each job, staking their own reputation. Third, the bond unlocks gradually as vouched work accumulates. Fourth, proven fraud burns the bond and bans the key for a year. Forging 10,000 identities would cost 800,000 POA, 10,000 hardware keys and 100,000 reviewer-days. A fake army rises like a plume of smoke; a real reputation grows like a cedar, slow, rooted, hard to fake.
